children: Asian currencies are increasingly diverging, J.P. Morgan Private Bank's Yuxuan Tang says in a note. Tang expects the Bank of Japan could prioritize currency stability, deliver 3-4 rate hikes over the next 12 months, taking policy rates to around 2%. Tang expects the dollar to hover around 160 yen. The Chinese yuan on the other hand could appreciate moderately into 2027 as exporters have become more willing to convert foreign-currency proceeds into yuan, she says. Tang remains cautious on the Indian rupee, as capital outflow pressure remains a key headwind. Meanwhile, the Australian dollar could be continued to be supported by the country's favorable terms of trade and a disciplined fiscal backdrop, she notes. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
